raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Under overload on Kimi-K3 (MI355X, TP8, chunked prefill + hybrid KDA/MLA), the scheduler could stall or fail allocations:
- A continuing chunk was sized only by the token budget, so it could ask `alloc_extend` for more KV than is free.
- A second unfinished chunked request could be admitted under policies other than shortest-prefill-first, even though only one can be tracked (assert crash).
- A latched `batch_is_full` was cleared only when the running batch shrank, so the waiting queue stalled.
- On the aiter backend, an over-capacity extend inside graph context could leave the chunked-KV path.

## Modifications

- `available_chunk_tokens` caps a continuing chunk by free + evictable KV, less the page `alloc_extend` over-asks. When that leaves nothing, the chunk proceeds with the free KV or is deferred.
- The one-chunked-request guard applies under every schedule policy.
- `batch_is_full` is re-evaluated every scheduling step; `PrefillAdder` still enforces the real limits.
- Over-capacity aiter extends stay on the chunked-KV path.

## Accuracy Tests

New unit tests (`test_prefill_memory_budget.py`, `test_prefill_adder.py`, `test_scheduler_batch_is_full_latch.py`, `test_aiter_attention_backend_handler.py`): all 5 new cases fail on `main` and pass with this PR (76 passed).
End to end, the Kimi-K3 MI355X production build includes these fixes. On a 40-min overload soak (48 concurrent requests against 12 slots), 901/901 completed requests returned 200, the queue peaked at 37, and there were 0 OOM, HSA or assert errors.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Scheduling only; no kernel change.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+"""An empty running batch never keeps admission closed (#41841)."""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import Mock
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase, maybe_stub_sgl_kernel
+
+maybe_stub_sgl_kernel()
+
+from sglang.srt.managers.schedule_batch import ScheduleBatch
+from sglang.srt.managers.scheduler import Scheduler
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=2, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class _AdmissionAttempted(Exception):
+    pass
+
+
+class TestEmptyBatchFullLatch(CustomTestCase):
+    def _scheduler(self) -> Scheduler:
+        s = Scheduler.__new__(Scheduler)
+        s.grammar_manager = SimpleNamespace(has_waiting_grammars=lambda: False)
+        s.enable_priority_preemption = False
+        s.waiting_queue = [SimpleNamespace(rid="req-0")]
+        s.chunked_req = None
+        s.min_free_slots_delayer = None
+        s.get_num_allocatable_reqs = Mock(return_value=8)
+        s.processed_tokens_counter = 0
+        s.disagg_prefill_bootstrap_queue = None
+        # Reaching the policy means the admission gates were passed.
+        s.policy = SimpleNamespace(calc_priority=Mock(side_effect=_AdmissionAttempted))
+        return s
+
+    def test_latched_empty_batch_still_admits(self):
+        # Whichever pass set the flag on an empty batch (no KV room, or no free
+        # request slot), no later step shrinks the batch to clear it.
+        s = self._scheduler()
+        running_batch = ScheduleBatch(reqs=[], batch_is_full=True)
+
+        with self.assertRaises(_AdmissionAttempted):
+            s._get_new_batch_prefill_raw(
+                prefill_delayer_single_pass=None, running_batch=running_batch
+            )
+        self.assertFalse(running_batch.batch_is_full)
+
+    def test_latched_running_batch_still_admits(self):
+        # Clearing the flag only when the batch shrinks would stall the queue
+        # until an unrelated request finishes.
+        s = self._scheduler()
+        running_batch = ScheduleBatch(
+            reqs=[SimpleNamespace(rid="running-0")], batch_is_full=True
+        )
+
+        with self.assertRaises(_AdmissionAttempted):
+            s._get_new_batch_prefill_raw(
+                prefill_delayer_single_pass=None, running_batch=running_batch
+            )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
